mapper.select: select p.* , g.game_name , g.game_alias , g.chzzk_game_name , u.nickname from post p inner join game_list g on p.game_id = g.game_id inner join user_info u on p.u_id = u.u_id where game_alias = upper(#{value})
select g.game_name , g.game_alias from post p inner join game_list g on p.game_id = g.game_id group by g.game_name , g.game_alias order by sum(view_count) desc fetch first 6 rows only
select distinct category from post where game_id in (select game_id from game_list where game_alias = upper(#{value}))

select row_number() over (order by (p.view_count + (10*p.like_count)) desc ) as "rownum" , p.* , u.nickname from post p inner join game_list g on p.created_at >= sysdate - 7 and p.game_id = g.game_id and g.game_alias = upper(#{value}) inner join user_info u on p.u_id = u.u_id order by (p.view_count + (10*p.like_count)) desc fetch first 3 rows only

select p.* , u.nickname , g.game_name , g.game_alias from post p inner join user_info u on p.u_id = u.u_id inner join game_list g on p.game_id = g.game_id where REPLACE(LOWER(title), ' ', '') like '%' || REPLACE(LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '') || '%'

select p.*, u.nickname , g.game_name , g.game_alias from post p inner join user_info u on p.u_id = u.u_id inner join game_list g on p.game_id = g.game_id where REPLACE(LOWER(content), ' ', '') like '%' || REPLACE(LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '') || '%'
select * from user_info where REPLACE(LOWER(nickname), ' ', '') like '%' || REPLACE(LOWER(#{keyword}), ' ', '') || '%'
select count(*) from post where game_id in (select game_id from game_list where game_alias = upper(#{gameAlias}))
select chzzk_game_name from game_list where game_alias = upper(#{gameAlias})
select * from post where game_id in (select game_id from game_list where game_alias = #{value})
